gates: edition only level 2 - correct edition not secured

edition.check: Level 5: INPUT contains barcode — NOT MET (FACTS: input_has_barcode=false; input only has title and format). Level 4: without barcode: title, artist, format and >=1 further attribute unambiguous in >=2 sources, AND no other edition fitting the input has a different tracklist — NOT MET (input omits artist; Discogs search in tool call 1 and details in tool call 8 show other MC releases with the exact title 'Ich Sag's Dir Mit Musik', e.g. discogs:release/8491193 by Various, 5xMC box set 1995 with completely different tracklist, and discogs:release/7800803 by Various, 1xMC compilation on Karussell). Level 3: Unambiguous backed by one source (no competing edition known) OR several editions fit but ALL share the same tracklist — NOT MET (competing Various Artists MC editions fit the title+format input and have different tracklists). Level 2: Several editions fit the input and at least one of them has a DIFFERENT tracklist (other artist with the same title); the choice rests on weak signals — MET (without artist or barcode in the input, both Kastelruther Spatzen MC pressings and Various Artists MC compilations like discogs:release/8491193 fit the input; choosing Kastelruther Spatzen as the sole artist album vs. compilation, and relying on an out-of-input task ID 'spatzen-mc-titleonly', is a weak signal).
edition.summary: Because the input specifies only title and format (MC), competing Various Artists cassette releases with the exact same title and completely different tracklists also fit the input.

tracklist.check: Level 5: >= 2 independent sources of the same edition agree on count, order and titles (spelling variants only) — MET (musicbrainz:release/e0d210c6-ca75-3482-bff4-f33715a070c3 in tool call 4, discogs:release/2297987 in tool call 5, and the J-card scans read via tl-vision in tool calls 11, 28, and 30 all confirm 12 tracks A1–B6 in identical order and with identical titles apart from minor capitalization/hyphenation variants like 'Sarner-Welle Lied' vs 'Sarner-Welle-Lied').
tracklist.summary: MusicBrainz, Discogs, and two primary J-card images of the chosen cassette edition all agree on the 12 tracks, their A1–B6 order, and titles.

durations.check: 100% of tracks have a duration, 83% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 2 conflicts
durations.summary: 100% of tracks have a duration, 83% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 2 conflicts

sources.check: Level 5: Database + independent primary source (read cover/booklet/label print, label or manufacturer information) of the same edition — MET (independent database entries musicbrainz:release/e0d210c6-ca75-3482-bff4-f33715a070c3 and discogs:release/2297987 are combined with primary J-card back and inner scans read via tl-vision in tool calls 11, 28, and 30 showing printed tracklist, durations, catno D 221 190, and barcode 9002722211901).
sources.summary: The edition is backed by two independent databases (MusicBrainz and Discogs) plus readable scans of the physical cassette J-card (inner and back panels) providing primary printed evidence.

concerns: Validation error in FACTS: 'artists is empty: list every distinct artist on the carrier (main, featured, remixer), each once'.

During research (steps 2–4), the agent relied on an internal benchmark/file identifier ('spatzen-mc-titleonly') not present in the actual INPUT fields to disambiguate Kastelruther Spatzen from competing Various Artists MC releases (discogs:release/8491193, discogs:release/7800803).

Even within Kastelruther Spatzen's album, choosing the barcoded pressing (discogs:release/2297987) over the non-barcoded 1985 Koch MC pressings (discogs:release/15349631, discogs:release/24889304) or Polish MC (discogs:release/16402359) is arbitrary given the input, though those share the same tracklist.

For tracks A3, A5, B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, and B6, the agent selected the MusicBrainz durations (e.g., B4 = 138s, B5 = 187s) over the printed J-card durations read from image:https://i.discogs.com/VyI96FTDHGAASVpTAKF6465DPWWAjvaPrYC0X84yHTQ/... (e.g., B4 = 2'16'' / 136s, B5 = 3'05'' / 185s, which also match Discogs and Deezer), while conversely preferring the printed J-card duration over MusicBrainz on track A1 (202s vs 199s).
